# Draft:Ancient Hue Garden Houses

----
Ancient Hue Garden House
Ancient Hue Garden House is a boutique hotel and heritage hospitality property located in Huế, Vietnam. It is part of the Ancient Hue brand, which was originally established in 2007 as a fine-dining restaurant focused on preserving and reinterpreting Huế royal and traditional Vietnamese cuisine. In 2019, the brand expanded its operations to include accommodation services with the development of Ancient Hue Garden House, integrating dining, architecture, and cultural experiences inspired by Huế’s imperial heritage.
History
The Ancient Hue brand was founded in 2007 as a restaurant dedicated to traditional Huế cuisine, drawing inspiration from royal dining traditions and regional culinary practices. From its inception, the restaurant emphasized the preservation of culinary heritage through curated menus and traditional preparation methods.
In 2019, Ancient Hue expanded beyond its original restaurant model with the launch of Ancient Hue Garden House, marking its entry into the hospitality sector. The garden house was developed within restored heritage architecture and designed to complement the brand’s culinary identity by offering guests accommodation combined with cultural and dining experiences.
Accommodation and facilities
Ancient Hue Garden House operates as a boutique garden house, offering accommodation within a landscaped heritage setting. The property incorporates traditional architectural elements, garden spaces, and interior designs influenced by central Vietnamese aesthetics. Facilities are designed to support a tranquil environment while maintaining proximity to the historic areas of Huế.
The accommodation concept emphasizes cultural immersion, combining lodging with heritage-inspired design and services associated with the Ancient Hue brand.
Dining
Dining is a central component of the Ancient Hue Garden House experience. The property houses Kim Long Dining, the brand’s flagship restaurant and the original foundation of Ancient Hue’s culinary identity.
Kim Long Dining traces its origins to the establishment of Ancient Hue in 2007 and continues to focus on Huế royal and traditional Vietnamese cuisine. The restaurant operates within the garden house setting and serves as a continuation of the brand’s original culinary vision.
Awards and recognition
In 2025, Ancient Hue Garden House received the Travellers’ Choice Award 2025, reflecting recognition from international travelers.
In the same year, Kim Long Dining was recognized as Trip Advisor Traveller's Choice Best of the Best 2025, acknowledging its standing among top-rated dining establishments in Hue city - Vietnam.
Ranked second among premium hotels in Huế on Trip.com.
Listed by Klook as one in top 10 resort experience in Huế.
Recognized by Scott Dunn as one of Vietnam’s top luxury hotels; only three properties in Huế are included in this selection.
